scope: Installed DSH Desktop; synthetic 270-turn and one-turn sessions; real local documents; no model calls or user history edits
checks: Group cards show shortened session titles with the full title on hover, and real Office thumbnails
Group thumbnails fill the cover; two files use both halves and short titles use a compact caption
Collapsed sessions align with file grid columns and preview at most four representative files
Temporary session files are hidden by default and can be revealed; ordinary documents in the OS temporary directory remain visible
Session groups start folded; expand, collapse and session filtering retain the correct files
All history pages collected; shared paths deduplicate, different directories stay separate
Confirmed missing references are excluded before cards, session counts and related-file recommendations are built
Existing corrupt and source-code files retain type covers; only confirmed absence is hidden
Stored generic attachment resolves through the native provider and previews real PDF bytes
Related files explain their reference relationship, open with keyboard or mouse, and retain source messages
Same file retains four exact source occurrences across two sessions
The reader file sidebar is at most 160 pixels wide
Photos-style details keep the filename fixed, show actual byte size, follow theme and close with Escape without reopening the preview
Source navigation loads the oldest history and scrolls to its stable message identity
An answer file switches from Trajectory to Chat and locates its corresponding question
100% fits completely in the real sidebar and workspace toolbars
Workspace plugin has the native localized title 文件工作台 and a package icon
Native plugin manager disables and enables File workspace independently of sidebar Preview
Workspace attachment preview remains functional while sidebar Preview is disabled
100% also fits at a 600-pixel Desktop window width
Narrow-window details become an inset bottom sheet and dismiss without leaving the document
Group cards fit a narrow window in both grid and list modes
Word, PowerPoint and Excel show real rendered thumbnails rather than fallback covers
A file deleted after scanning disappears when opened, including navigation and related-file lists
Refreshing rechecks existence and restores a file recreated at the same path
